identity_check: Confirmed as Atoms (atoms.co), Travis Kalanick's physical-automation group: atoms.co lists its units CloudKitchens, Otter, Lab37, Picnic, ProFood (food), Pronto AI (mining) and a transport unit, and Kalanick's 'unfinished business' post on atoms.co announces the $1.7B a16z-led equity investment, the same round verified in cache/round-atoms.json (TNW, same domain). CB Insights' City Storage Systems profile lists atoms.co as the website and calls the company Atoms, and Wikipedia gives Atoms, Inc. as CloudKitchens' parent; Kalanick's post says the businesses were merged into one Atoms equity structure, so City Storage Systems / CloudKitchens rounds are recorded as Atoms' earlier history. Not any unrelated company named Atoms. Category kept remote and layer robotics: Atoms builds specialised robots and automation for food, mining and heavy transport, not software agents for factory functions.
